_comment: CLOSED Dreamer loop v10loop (2026-10-19; PREPARED, NOT LAUNCHED). Replace REPO_SHA before starting. Closed iteration: collect -> convert -> WM fine-tune -> policy update in the new WM -> SUMO check vs the native reference -> rollback/log. Iteration 0 already ran (runs/c4_wm_v10_iter000) so the loop starts from that existing WM (wm.iter0_mode='existing') and only trains the policy from scratch. lane_learnable lives on the physical envelope key physics.lane_learnable (c4/v10unblock); the c4/v10horizon curriculum/replay keys are NOT merged yet and stay in the separate list wm.extra_set_horizon (empty by default).

seed.used_note: Ranges inside the C4_LOOP_TRAIN parent 966000-969999 already consumed elsewhere (10-19); they are outside this block 966000-966999. Re-grep the remote ledgers before a real launch (used_ledger_globs).

ship_commands: scp /tmp/repo_{sha}.tgz cpuN:~/c4/ && ssh cpuN 'cd ~/c4 && rm -rf repo_{sha} && tar -xzf repo_{sha}.tgz && md5sum repo_{sha}.tgz'
echo 'compare the gpuR and cpuN md5 lines above; they must be identical before collection'
collect.ship_note: gpuR builds repo_<sha>.tgz, scp's it to cpuN:~/c4/, unpacks it and prints both md5 lines; the entrance-mask loader dir ships alongside. Verified manually from the dry-run output before run --execute.
collect._note_hosts: 10-19: gpuR->cpuN SSH added (key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_cpun on gpuR, Host cpuN in gpuR ~/.ssh/config); collection split gpuR 140 / cpuN 60.

wm.iter0_wm_note: Iteration-0 WM training is already running on gpuR (manual launch: --set physics.lane_learnable=true --set curriculum.stage_steps=[200,150] --set curriculum.max_hours=4.0, init /root/autodl-tmp/c4/v5/wm_v5m/wm_s_best_ap.pt md5 d736db86). With iter0_mode='existing' the loop skips the iteration-0 WM stage and trains the policy from scratch on iter0_wm_out/wm_s_best.pt. Set iter0_mode='train' to re-run the WM bootstrap instead.

lane_calib._note: LANERATECAL: fits one additive logit offset per fitted lane head so the WM free-rollout lane-change counts match SUMO on TRAIN-val starts; writes <wm_out>/lane_calib.json, which load_checkpoint reads when the policy stage loads the same checkpoint. Run after wm_check and before policy_update on a many-core CPU host (gpuR).

wm.laneflow_note: FIX 2 (LANEFLOW.md): the on-policy count-matching lane-change loss (loss.lane_flow, V8LANE) under physics.lane_learnable. wm.extra_set_laneflow is merged into every iteration >= 1 WM fine-tune (never iteration 0). weight 1.0 / balance 0.5 match the trained V8LANE checkpoint (configs/c4_wm_v8lane_short3.toml); the term needs lane_model='hazard_v5' (v5m refresh) and no longer needs model.lane_v5_mainline='budget'.
wm.pass_through_note: Verbatim --set items: physics.lane_learnable (c4/v10unblock), wm.extra_set_horizon (c4/v10horizon, merged), wm.extra_set_laneflow (loss.lane_flow, iterations >= 1). The loop never parses or renames them.

policy.physics_note: train_cli loads the --wm-ckpt via wms.eval.backend and imagines with the checkpoint's physics.json; a WM trained with physics.lane_learnable=true writes lane_learnable=true there, so the policy imagines inside the physical lane envelope. Verify: python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('<iter0_wm_out>/physics.json'))['lane_learnable'])" must print True before the iter-0 policy update.

check.native_ref_note: sumo_check_v8pol_u600/native was collected with the policy-check flags (2400 vph, 0.4, product, warmup 300, horizon 600, normal_car, textbook) - same as all v9/v10 autochecks.
check.fixed_val_note: 48 deterministic TRAIN-val states from data/v5_native val windows; generated once with scripts/c4/wm_fidelity_v10.py --states <v5_native val states> --select 48 --save-selection <fixed_val_states>.
